architecture.description: what stands: the structure a system has, rather than one being proposed

design.description: a change being proposed; what it is, is written in the doc beside it. `proposed` and `decided` carry its lifecycle

design_new.title: Propose a design
design_new.description: Create a proposal with design{}, doc{title, body} and proposed{}, stamped as the caller. Returns applied bundles.

title.description: what the design proposes, in one line

project.description: the project to file it under; pass its id or registered name

design_decide.title: Decide a design
design_decide.description: Record approval or decline. by records a person's explicit decision; otherwise the caller decides. Returns applied bundles.

design.description: id or registered name of the design proposal to decide

verdict.description: decision to record: approved (default) or declined

by.description: Person whose explicit decision is recorded.

verdict.description: approved, rejected, or approved once these changes are made

review.description: one person's assessment of a design: the verdict, and the comment beside it
